text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, when I went to the cafeteria,
Hokko Tarumae was fretting over something.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: No...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer-san.
Actually, I was wondering if we could create
a new specialty product using haskap berries...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: I was wondering if we could get people to recognize haskap berries as something familiar they can enjoy anytime...
choice_data_list: It's tricky when it comes to familiar things.
It's tricky when it comes to familiar things.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
That's right. We already have jam, so
maybe we should approach it from a different angle――

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (SPLAAAASH!!)

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Great on hamburg steak! Great on omurice!
For salads, for sashimi, all you need is this one bottle!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
The special sauce really does
go with everything, yes it does!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me!
Could you tell me about that sauce?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ¿Qué!? What is this all of a sudden?!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: I've been thinking about how to make Tomakomai's specialty goods mainstream.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"I want to use that 'goes with anything' sauce
as a reference!"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Bueno!!
If that's the case, leave it all to El!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, El's sauce is a secret sauce!
I cannot share the recipe!"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Huh... I-Is that so...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
No-no! I cannot give you the recipe,
but I can offer advice!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Really? Then I'll leave it to you!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Hmm, the mix is good, but the acidity is drowning out the spices...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Even so, if I don't put haskap berries in it,
it defeats the whole purpose...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Looks like you're in need of my special, top-tier advice right about now!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Listen up, everyone! To put it plainly!
What we need is burning passion!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: A burning passion for one's homeland is what brings the sauce together as one, YES!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ! I see...! When you say passion—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: "In this case, that means turning up the spices!"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"Exactly!!
That's what El would doooo!!"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Got it! Thank you.
My feelings for my homeland... I'll pour in even more passion...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Feeling a slight sense of unease, I watched the two of them develop their sauce—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Trainer, it's finished!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
It's an El-guaranteed sauce!!
It's bound to be so delicious you'll jump for joy-desu!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
If you don't mind,
could I also hear your opinion, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Put that way, I can hardly refuse.
Apprehensively, I bring the purple sauce to my mouth...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Beneath the heat wafts the aroma of haskap.
While it crossed my mind that some might enjoy it,
the burning spice overwhelmingly overpowered everything else."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
What do you think? Could it become an all-purpose
seasoning on par with soy sauce, Worcestershire, and mayo?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ...Is that so.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hokko Tarumae slumped her shoulders in dejection.
She must have had truly high hopes for that sauce.
choice_data_list: Might be good for people who like spicy food.
The speed with which you made the prototype was magnificent.
The speed with which you made the prototype was magnificent!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hokko Tarumae slumped her shoulders in dejection.
She must have had truly high hopes for that sauce.
choice_data_list: Might be good for people who like spicy food.
The speed with which you made the prototype was magnificent.
The speed with which you made the prototype was magnificent!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
However, what I am aiming for
is an "all-purpose sauce that goes with anything."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: "There can be no compromising here! We keep developing until the flavor satisfies!"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
El-san, Trainer-san,
I look forward to continuing to work with you!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Bueno! I love that spirit!
Let's develop the ultimate sauce together!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Hokko Tarumae became even more
motivated for the sake of Tomakomai.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Well... thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
In that case, for now we have no choice but to keep
trying through trial and error at this pace.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Yes! El's sauce has been refined again and again
ever since Papa's papa's generation to reach today's flavor, desu!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Taking your time to build things up is the fastest shortcut of all!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
El-san...! Got it. I'll keep
working on developing the sauce!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
Please help me with taste-testing from time to time, okay?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, I found myself frequently asked
to be the taste tester for this super-spicy haskap sauce.
